title: CivetWeb through 1.16, when built with USE_HTTP2 and enable_http2 on, contains a use-after-free vulnerability in…
description: CivetWeb versions up to 1.16, when built with HTTP/2 support enabled, contain a use-after-free vulnerability in the HTTP/2 request handling function. This flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to manipulate HTTP/2 HEADERS frames to influence the request method or path used by access control rules or cause a server crash.
